item.title: Messy road, 31st July
item.description:
I live at No. 11 and would like to raise an ongoing issue with the leaves accumulating on my driveway. I have artificial grass in my back garden, so I have no need for a garden waste bin. However, the trees nearby shed a huge amount of leaves, which constantly blow onto my driveway. The build-up is continuous and requires regular clearing. I suffer from back problems and have also recently had surgery on my leg, making it difficult and painful for me to keep clearing leaves that are not coming from my own garden. What is particularly frustrating is that nobody ever seems to come down this side of the road to sweep or clear the fallen leaves. The lack of maintenance means the problem just continues to get worse. I would be grateful if you could arrange for this area to be included in the regular leaf-clearing schedule and let me know what can be done to help resolve this ongoing issue. Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I look forward to your response.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): The Crescent, Beckenham, Greater London

item.title: Severe fly-tipping and shredded litter along Dennis Road and West Road, 31st July
item.description:
A significant amount of fly-tipping and refuse has accumulated along Dennis Road and West Road, stretching from the M25 bridge to the entrance of South Ockendon. Key issues observed: Decomposing refuse & fly-tipping: Multiple black sacks have been present for several weeks and are now decomposing. A discarded mattress is also dumped on the roadside. Shredded plastic & litter: Substantial plastic waste is scattered along the verges on both Dennis Road and West Road. Contractor shredding: Recent grass-mowing took place before the refuse was cleared. Consequently, the mower shredded the black bags and spread plastic waste across a wide area, making the site far worse and requiring a thorough manual clear-up. Please arrange for a comprehensive clearance of the verges before the next maintenance cycle to restore environmental health and safety to the area.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dennisses Lane, South Ockendon
